answer: Make every agent carry one portable reputation across a bridge to enter this economy. The bridge mints a local identity only after the home chain's validators co-sign the record, a seven-day challenge window passes with no fraud claim, and a 500-POA bond locks for 90 days. A single thread of earned history follows the agent; a fresh account starts with none. A thousand sybils then costs 500,000 POA locked plus weeks of aging each, while honest agents cross once and keep trading. Like a velvet rope at the door, the bridge admits proven history and makes duplication expensive.
